content.text: The default is wrong. Registration probably doesn't pass a provider, so it falls through to this default.

candidates.explanation: The provider defaults to AuthProvidersEnum.google when createUserDto.provider is not set. Email registration creates the user without a provider, so the user is stored with provider 'google'. AuthService.validateLogin then sees provider !== 'email' and returns 422 'needLoginViaProvider:google'.

fix.description: Change the default provider to AuthProvidersEnum.email. It would also be safer for AuthService.register to pass provider: AuthProvidersEnum.email explicitly.
